## Peter Jackson's King Kong PC Port

Play the Xbox 360 version of Peter Jackson's King Kong natively on Windows, with a launcher and modern PC options.

### What you need
Your own copy of the Xbox 360 disc (USA/Europe, title ID `555307D3`, version `0.0.0.1`) as a disc image (`.iso`). SHA-1: `075F43709E9C9A095E099AB5056CC04B768288D1`. See the README for details.

### How to install
1. Download the **KingKong-Builder** zip below and unzip it.
2. Double-click **Build King Kong.bat**.
3. Let it install the build tools if it asks (a one-time download of about 6 GB).
4. Pick your King Kong disc image.
5. After 20 to 40 minutes the game is ready in the **KingKong** folder.

The builder makes the PC version on your computer from your own copy of the game. **No game files are included or downloaded.**

### What's in it
- The game plays past the "VENTURE" opening, which freezes on Xenia, with working music and voice lines
- A launcher with art from your copy of the game
- Up to 8K resolution, FXAA, 2x MSAA and 16x texture filtering
- 30 fps like the console, or up to 240 and unlimited (some animations are not right above 30 yet)
- Xbox 360 style achievement pop-ups, with your own choice of sound
- Camera inversion and speed, deadzone, vibration, button remapping, keyboard and mouse

A full play-through has not been tested yet. Please report anything that goes wrong.

Linux AppImage coming soon.

This build was made with AI (Claude Code). See the README for details.
